C++ 核心业务与 IoT 接入： 使用 C++ 编写高性能的底层交互与设备接入代码，通过 MQTT、WebSocket、TCP Socket 等协议，实现产线状态的毫秒级采集与设备级控制指令的精准下发。
跨模块全链路 Debug 与系统调优： 扮演系统级Troubleshooter。在面对“设备卡死”、“丢包”、“指令时序错乱”等复杂生产事故时，能够跨越网络层、业务逻辑层和底层硬件，进行高效的抓包、日志排查与根因分析（RCA）。
OTA 远程升级架构落地： 设计并开发针对边缘计算节点、网关及自动化设备的 OTA（Over-The-Air）差分升级模块，确保固件与软件更新的安全性、断点续传能力及失败回滚机制。
集中日志与告警平台建设： 从 0 到 1 搭建涵盖全业务链路的集中式日志分析与可视化告警平台（如基于 ELK 或 Prometheus/Grafana 生态），实现对系统健康度、Slow SQL 及异常状态的提前预警。

数据库与架构设计： 熟悉关系型数据库（MySQL / PostgreSQL）设计与性能调优；熟练掌握 Redis、Kafka/RabbitMQ 等中间件在分布式系统解耦与削峰中的应用。
物联网与通信技能： 深入理解 TCP/IP 协议栈，熟悉 MQTT、WebSocket 等即时通信协议以及 JSON/Protobuf 等数据序列化技术。

具备 AMR（自主移动机器人）系统、ROS/ROS2 开发或车队调度系统（FMS）经验者属于极度稀缺人才，优先重点考虑。

熟悉工业现场底层通信协议，如 OPC UA、Modbus TCP、EtherCAT 等。
具备 Docker/Kubernetes 容器化部署经验，了解 CI/CD 自动化流水线建设。

Overview
ClearMotion is seeking a hands-on Systems Engineer to support our actuator manufacturing operations in Changshu, China. This role is focused on technical problem solving on the production line, including root cause analysis of actuator performance issues, investigation of test failures, and continuous improvement of product performance, quality, and cost. The ideal candidate is highly analytical, comfortable working in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, and passionate about using data to uncover and resolve complex problems. The role involves frequent collaboration with engineering teams in the United States, requiring strong English communication skills. The candidate must be able to demonstrate experience with automotive products specifically in the development and production phases. 

Key Responsibilities
•	Lead root cause analysis for actuator issues identified during manufacturing, test, or field evaluation
•	Maintain and improve existing MATLAB tools used to analyze manufacturing and product test data.
•	Develop and release new data analysis MATLAB tools to support troubleshooting, validate design/process changes, and monitor production.
•	Analyze large data sets from production and test systems to identify trends, failure modes, or process deviations
•	Collaborate closely with manufacturing, quality, and design engineering teams to implement corrective actions
•	Interface with OEM engineering teams to collect and process field data from end customers and other tests.
•	Frequently collaborate with U.S. based engineering teams to align on issues, share findings, and implement solutions across sites.
•	Design, plan, and execute experiments to validate hypotheses and drive product enhancements
•	Prepare clear technical reports summarizing findings, conclusions, and recommended corrective actions
•	Support deployment of data-driven solutions and best practices across the production line
Qualifications	
•	Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Systems Engineering, or related field
•	Strong experience using MATLAB for data analysis, visualization, and reporting (required)
•	Demonstrated track record of using data to identify product or process issues (multiple concrete examples expected)
•	Experience in root cause analysis, failure investigation, or reliability engineering within manufacturing or hardware development
•	Familiarity with experimental design, validation testing, and statistical analysis
•	Ability to work on-site in Changshu and interact daily with manufacturing and test operations teams
•	Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to independently structure investigations and drive issues to closure
•	Excellent written and verbal English communication skills for documenting analyses and presenting findings
Preferred Experience
•	Prior experience in actuator, automotive, motion control, or electromechanical systems manufacturing
•	Knowledge of manufacturing test systems, end-of-line testing, or production quality processes
•	Prior experience in writing technical documents such as engineering requirements, supplier specifications, work instructions, or testing methods. 
•	Knowledge with CAN communication and Labview is desirable
•	Extensive experience with Matlab tools

岗位概述 

科力梦行（ClearMotion）现招聘一名实操型系统工程师，常驻常熟执行器生产工厂，支撑公司执行器量产制造业务。本岗位核心工作聚焦产线技术难题攻关，包含执行器性能故障根因分析、各类测试失效问题排查，同时持续迭代优化产品性能、品质与生产成本。
理想候选人需具备极强数据分析思维，能适应快节奏量产工厂工作环境，擅长依托海量数据挖掘、解决复杂工程问题。岗位需高频与美国总部研发团队协同，因此要求优秀的英语读写、口语沟通能力。候选人必须拥有汽车类产品开发、量产落地阶段完整实战经验。

核心工作职责 

1.牵头对生产、台架测试、终端市场反馈的各类执行器故障开展完整根因分析（RCA）
2.维护、迭代现有用于工厂生产、产品测试数据分析的 MATLAB 工具
3.独立开发并上线全新 MATLAB 数据分析工具，用于故障定位、设计 / 工艺变更验证、全流程量产状态监控
4.解析产线、测试设备输出的海量数据集，挖掘失效规律、典型失效模式、工艺偏移问题
5.紧密协同生产、质量、研发设计团队，落地对应的整改纠正措施
6对接整车厂（OEM）研发团队，采集、处理终端客户实车路试与各类测试反馈数据
7.常态化对接美国研发团队，同步故障信息、共享分析结论，中美两地同步落地统一解决方案
8.自主设计、规划、开展验证试验，验证故障假设，推动产品性能迭代升级
9.输出逻辑清晰、内容完整的专业技术报告，汇总故障现象、分析结论、整改优化建议
10.在全厂范围推广数据驱动的问题解决方案与标准化优化作业流程

2.熟练运用 MATLAB 完成数据分析、可视化图表、技术报告输出（必备硬性条件，不可替代）
3.有完整落地项目案例证明：依靠数据定位产品缺陷、工艺问题（面试需提供多个真实项目实例）
4.拥有制造工厂、硬件研发场景下根因分析、失效排查、可靠性工程相关实操经验
5.熟悉试验设计、验证测试、工程统计分析整套方法论
6.可常驻常熟厂区办公，每日对接生产、测试一线作业团队
7.具备主动独立解决问题的思维，可自主搭建完整故障排查流程，全程推动问题闭环
8.优秀英文书面、口语能力，可独立撰写分析文档、线上向美方团队汇报分析结论

熟悉工厂测试设备、下线 EOL 检测、量产全流程质量管控体系
